notes: Browser tokenizer regenerates every tensor with exact Python parity; DOM collection/template formatting excluded.
Local loopback asset loading; not internet-download timing.
Whole isolated Chromium process-set working set, observed at milestones; not continuous peak or model-only physical RAM.

Worker teardown is an explicit lifecycle action after all cases, not implicit proof of background memory reclamation.

nativeReference.note: Native and WASM numerical equality is not assumed. Score differences and top-choice agreement are separate from successful inference and exact tokenizer parity.

mainThreadTimer.note: Diagnostic timer intervals include loading, reporting and browser scheduling; not a user interaction latency metric.
